Title: The Lost Vikings Patch
Subtitle: Closed Beta patch 0.9.0.34053 (February 10, 2015) introducing The Lost Vikings (Olaf, Baleog, and Erik) along with hero balance updates for Abathur, Anub'arak, Arthas, Brightwing, Chen, Diablo, Illidan, Kerrigan, Muradin, Murky, Raynor, Rehgar, Sgt. Hammer, Sonya, Stitches, Thrall, Tychus, Tyrael, Uther, and Zeratul.
Highlights: Closed Beta patch 0.9.0.34053 (February 10, 2015) introducing The Lost Vikings (Olaf, Baleog, and Erik) along with hero balance updates for Abathur, Anub'arak, Arthas, Brightwing, Chen, Diablo, Illidan, Kerrigan, Muradin, Murky, Raynor, Rehgar, Sgt. Hammer, Sonya, Stitches, Thrall, Tychus, Tyrael, Uther, and Zeratul.
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Updates]
  • Evolve Monstrosity (R):
  • - Minion Stack bonus increased from 4% to 5% Health and Damage.
  • - Monstrosity Health increased from 600 (+60 per level) to 600 (+72 per level).
  • - Monstrosity now takes 50% less damage from Minions and Structures.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Abathur's Hivemind can no longer benefit Vehicles.
  • Fixed an issue in which Abathur could become permanently stuck in Symbiote form under very specific circumstances.
  • Abathur's Bombard Strain now appropriately lists a 66% damage bonus for Locusts in its tooltip.
  • Visual effects for Abathur's Deep Tunnel are no longer visible through line of sight blockers for opponents when Symbiote is cancelled.

=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Updates]
  • Basic Attack:
  • - Locust Needles (Talent) damage increased from 35% to 50%.
  • Impale (Q):
  • - Stun duration decreased from 1.25 to 1 second.
  • Harden Carapace (W):
  • - Persistent Carapace (Talent): Duration bonus increased from 2 to 3 seconds.
  • - Chitinous Plating (Talent): Shield bonus reduced from 50% to 40%.
  • Burrow Charge (E):
  • - Cooldown increased from 14 to 16 seconds.
  • - Epicenter (Talent): Impact area and Damage bonuses reduced from 100% to 85%.
  • Web Blast (R):
  • - Duration increased from 5 to 8 seconds.
  • - Cooldown increased from 45 to 60 seconds.
  • - Cryptweave (Talent): Now channels for 4 seconds to increase the duration of Web Blast for 4 seconds; usable once per Web Blast cast.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause Anub'arak to become stuck after using Burrow Charge near a Wall.
  • Heroes will no longer be teleported back to Stitches if they are Gorged when Stitches comes under the effects of Anub'arak's Web Blast.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  • Envenom (Talent) removed.
  • Frozen Wastes (Talent) moved from Level 1 to Level 4.
  • Eternal Hunter (Talent) moved from Level 4 to Level 1.
  • Basic Attack:
  • - Rune Tap (Talent): Heal amount reduced from 4% to 3% of maximum Health.
  • Frostmourne Hungers (Trait):
  • - Obliterate (Talent): Search radius increased by 25%.
  • Death Coil (Q):
  • - Mana Cost decreased from 55 to 50.
  • Howling Blast (W):
  • - Mana cost decreased from 75 to 70.
  • - Frost Presence (Talent): Cooldown reduction increased from 2 to 3 seconds.
  • Frozen Tempest (E):
  • - Mana drain increased from 12 to 15 per second.
  • - Radius increased by approximately 15%.
  • - Initial damage per second increased from 20 to 26.
  • - Scaling damage increased from 3 to 4.
  • - Frozen Wastes (Talent): No longer increases Frozen Tempest's radius; now decreases Frozen Tempest's Mana cost by 3 per second.
  • - Biting Cold (Talent): No longer increases Frozen Tempest's Mana cost; scaling damage increased from 5.5 to 6.
  • Summon Sindragosa (R):
  • - Cooldown decreased from 90 to 80 seconds.
  • - Slow duration on Heroes increased from 3 to 4 seconds.
  • - Absolute Zero (Talent): Hero root duration increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds; Hero slow duration increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds.
  • Army of the Dead (R):
  • - Cooldown increased from 90 to 100 seconds.
  • - Initial Ghoul heal reduced from 150 to 104.
  • - Scaling Ghoul heal reduced from 30 to 24.
  • - Legion of Northrend (Talent): Ghoul duration bonus changed from a 50% increase to a 5 second increase; now increases Ghoul heal by 25%.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Updates]
  • Bolt of the Storm (Talent) added at Level 20.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Internal text will no longer display when Azmodan's Demons kill Murky's Egg.
  • Visual explosion effects for Azmodan's Globe of Annihilation with the Sieging Wrath Talent will now properly appear at long distances.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Updates]
  • Starting Health decreased from 775 to 750.
  • Scaling Health decreased from 140 to 130.
  • Rewind (Talent) moved from Level 13 to Level 20.
  • Bolt of the Storm (Talent) removed.
  • Phase Shift (Z):
  • - Cooldown increased from 30 to 45 seconds.
  • - Phase Shield (Talent): Shield scaling increased from 25 to 50 per level.
  • Polymorph (W):
  • - Mana Cost increased from 60 to 75.
  • Pixie Dust (E):
  • - Buff duration decreased from 4 to 3 seconds.
  • - Movement Speed bonus decreased from 25% to 20%.
  • - Block charges granted reduced from 2 to 1.
  • - Cooldown decreased from 12 to 10 seconds.
  • - Mana Cost reduced from 75 to 60.
[Bug Fixes]
  • A Sgt. Hammer in Siege Mode now properly becomes mobile while under the effects of Brightwing's Polymorph, and will no longer be in Siege Mode when Polymorph expires.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Updates]
  • Brew resource bar color changed to yellow.
  • Swift Reflexes (Talent) moved from Level 7 to Level 4.
  • Basic Attack:
  • - Attack Speed increased by 11%.
  • Fortifying Brew (Trait):
  • - Last Drop (Talent) removed.
  • - Bottomless Mug (Talent) moved from Level 4 to Level 1.
  • - Chug (Talent) moved from Level 4 to Level 16.
  • - Combat Stance (Talent) moved from Level 16 to Level 7.
  • - Starting Brew regeneration increased from 30 to 40 Brew per second upon activation.
  • - Bolder Flavor (Talent): Moved from Level 7 to Level 16; shield regeneration rate and maximum Shield amount increased from 33% to 40%.
  • - Brewmaster's Balance (Talent): Health regeneration bonus increased from 5 (+1 per level) to 10 (+1.5 per level); Movement Speed bonus increased from 15% to 20%; bonuses swapped (at or below 50 Brew: 20% Movement Speed; at or above 50 Brew: +10 (+1.5 per level) Health per second).
  • Flying Kick (Q):
  • - Deadly Strike (Talent) moved from Level 1 to Level 4.
  • - Pressure Point (Talent): Moved from Level 7 to Level 16; no longer roots for 1 second, instead applies a 90% slow for 1 second.
  • - Combination Attack (Talent): Attack damage bonus decreased from 200% to 100%.
  • Keg Smash (W):
  • - Keg Toss (Talent): Moved from Level 16 to Level 7; range bonus reduced from 200% to 125%.
  • Breath of Fire (E):
  • - Combustion (Talent) removed.
  • - Deep Breath (Talent): Range and arc increases changed from 20% to 30%.
  • - Ring of Fire (Talent): Damage scaling increased from 2 to 2.5.
  • Storm, Earth, Fire (R):
  • - Elemental Conduit (Talent): Spirit timed life decreased from 5 to 4 seconds; Spirit generation cooldown decreased from 9 to 4 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Spirits created by Chen's Storm, Earth, Fire Heroic Ability can no longer capture the Dragon Knight on Dragon Shire.
  • Visual effects for Chen's Brewmaster's Balance Talent will no longer persist after Chen is killed.
  • Chen's ready sound can no longer be heard by all players during Hero Selection.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Updates]
  • Basic Attack:
  • - Scaling damage increased from 7 to 11.
  • Shadow Charge (Q):
  • - Pushback distance on target is now consistent for smoother combos with Overpower.
  • - Can now be used on Structures without potentially landing inside of them.
  • Fire Stomp (W):
  • - Now orients according to cardinal directions relative to Diablo's facing direction.
  • - Number of fire waves created by Fire Stomp has been reduced from 10 to 8.
  • Overpower (E):
  • - Issuing additional commands after casting Overpower is now more responsive.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Falstad's Flight cooldown is now properly reset after pressing the "Clear Cooldowns" button in Try Mode.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed a rare issue which could allow Gazlowe to use both Grav-O-Bomb 3,000 and Robo-Goblin in the same match.

=== Heroes: Illidan ===
[Updates]
  • Executioner (Talent) removed.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Corrected some minor clipping in Illidan's Master Skin model.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Updates]
  • Executioner (Talent) removed.
  • Ravage (Q):
  • - Siphoning Impact (Talent): Heal amount increased from 5% to 10% of maximum Health.
  • Impaling Blades (W):
  • - Starting damage decreased from 125 to 110; scaling damage increased from 20 to 22.
  • Primal Grasp (E):
  • - Psionic Pulse (Talent): Base damage tick increased from 3 to 6; scaling damage tick increased from 0.65 to 1.2.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Kerrigan's Ultralisk can now properly walk through uncollected Doubloons on Blackheart's Bay.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Updates]
  • Stormbolt (Q):
  • - Sledgehammer (Talent): 400% damage bonus now also affects Mercenaries.
  • Haymaker (R):
  • - Casting time slightly reduced.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Muradin's Haymaker now deals the appropriate amount of damage to Grave Golems and player-controlled Garden Terrors.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Updates]
  • Murky now loses Kill Streak flames any time he is killed, even if an Egg has been placed prior to death.
  • Gathering Power (Talent) removed.
  • Spawn Egg (Trait):
  • - Egg placement cooldown reduced from 45 to 20 seconds.
  • - Time Murky is revealed after his Egg is killed increased from 10 to 15 seconds.
  • - Placement cooldown after Murky's Egg is destroyed decreased from 20 to 15 seconds.
  • Pufferfish (W):
  • - Slimy Pufferfish (Talent) moved from Level 7 to Level 16.
  • - Compressed Air (Talent) moved from Level 13 to Level 7.
  • - Wrath of Cod (Talent) moved from Level 16 to Level 13.
  • Safety Bubble (E):
  • - Rejuvenation Bubble (Talent): Now restores 50% Health rather than all Health.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Internal text will no longer display when Azmodan's Demons kill Murky's Egg.
  • Lighting issues will no longer occur when Murky is revived at an Egg placed in the Haunted Mines.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Nova's Holo Decoy will no longer pick up Doubloons on Blackheart's Bay if Nova is killed before the Decoy expires.
  • Nova's Holo Decoy now appropriately displays any Doubloons it collects on Blackheart's Bay.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Updates]
  • Significant Talent update:
  • - Searing Attacks (Talent) removed.
  • - Mercenary Lord (Talent) added at Level 7.
  • - New Level 1 Talent — Raynor's "Recruitment": Improved Bribe requiring 15 stacks instead of 20.
  • - New Level 16 Talent — Relentless Leader: 50% Crowd Control reduction, plus a knockback on nearby enemies when stunned (once every 5 seconds).
  • - New Level 20 Talent — A Card to Play: Heroic Ability cooldown reduced by 10 seconds whenever any Hero (ally or enemy) is killed.
  • Lead From the Front (Trait) removed.
  • Advanced Optics (Talent) converted into Raynor's new Trait, also increasing vision by 10%.
  • - New Level 13 Talent — Puttin' On a Clinic: Reduces Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds whenever an enemy recently damaged by Raynor is destroyed.
  • Basic Attack:
  • - Damage reduced from 40 (+12 per level) to 35 (+11 per level).
  • Penetrating Round (Q):
  • - New Level 4 Talent — Confident Aim: Cooldown reduced by 4 seconds upon striking an enemy Hero.
  • - New Level 7 Talent — Hamstring Shot: Slows enemies by 20% for 3 seconds on impact.
  • - New Level 13 Talent — Double Barreled: Becomes charge-based with up to 2 charges.
  • Inspire (W):
  • - Attack damage bonus removed.
  • - Attack Speed bonus increased from 15% to 25% (nearby allies still receive 50% of this bonus).
  • - No longer visually scales up Minions and Mercenaries.
  • - New Level 13 Talent — Steel Resolve: Increases Inspire duration by 50% and causes Adrenaline Rush to automatically apply Inspire.
  • Adrenaline Rush (E):
  • - Activated Rush (Talent) moved from Level 13 to Level 4; now dismounts Raynor upon activation.
  • - No longer requires activation to reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown; cooldown reduction lowered from 15 to 10 seconds.
  • Hyperion (R):
  • - Battle Hyperion (Talent) removed.
  • - Now starts with the Yamato Cannon effect previously granted by the Battle Hyperion Talent.
  • - New Level 20 Talent — Scorched Earth: Additional lasers continually blast the ground for area-of-effect damage.
  • Raynor's Raiders (R):
  • - Now requires a target before it can be cast.
  • - Banshees can be re-targeted by pressing R and clicking an enemy, or issued Move commands by pressing R and clicking terrain.
  • - Banshees acquire a nearby target (preferring Heroes) if their target dies, and travel to the nearest lane to push if Raynor dies.
  • - New Level 20 Talent — Dusk Wings: Banshees remain cloaked while firing and fire 50% more frequently.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Updates]
  • Earthbind Totem (E):
  • - Earthgrasp Totem (Talent): No longer roots for 1 second, instead applies a 90% slow for 1 second.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Great-father Winter Rehgar's appearance while in Ghost Wolf form will now appropriately match his selected Skin Variation.

=== Heroes: Sgt. Hammer ===
[Updates]
  • Spider Mines (Q):
  • - Bullhead Mines (Talent): Enemies knocked back slightly farther, but only the center of the three Spider Mines knocks targets back.
[Bug Fixes]
  • A Sgt. Hammer in Siege Mode now properly becomes mobile while under the effects of Brightwing's Polymorph, and will no longer be in Siege Mode when Polymorph expires.
  • Visual explosion effects from Sgt. Hammer's Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode now appear at the appropriate location when attacking flying enemies.

=== Heroes: Sonya ===
[Updates]
  • Fury resource bar color changed to orange.
  • Ferocious Healing (Activated Talent): Fury cost upon activation increased from 10 to 20.
  • Basic Attack:
  • - Damage increased from 38 (+7 per level) to 40 (+8 per level).
  • Fury (Trait):
  • - Fury generated per Basic Attack increased from 4 to 6.
  • - Fury generated upon taking damage increased from 1 to 2.
  • - Shot of Fury (Talent): Fury generated upon activation increased from 25 to 50.
  • Ancient Spear (Q):
  • - Fury generation increased from 20 to 40.
  • Seismic Slam (W):
  • - Fury cost increased from 15 to 25.
  • - Furious Blow (Talent): Damage bonus increased from 30% to 40%; increase to Seismic Slam's Fury cost changed from 5 to 10.
  • Whirlwind (E):
  • - Fury cost increased from 30 to 50.
  • Wrath of the Berserker (R):
  • - Cooldown increased from 30 to 45 seconds.
  • - Damage bonus increased from 30% to 40%.
  • - Duration increased from 10 to 15 seconds.
  • - Fury required to extend Wrath of the Berserker's duration increased from 4 to 10 Fury.

=== Heroes: Stitches ===
[Updates]
  • Hook (Q):
  • - Cooldown increased from 14 to 16 seconds.
  • Gorge (R):
  • - Damage reduced from 200 (+50 per level) to 100 (+25 per level).
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heroes will no longer be teleported back to Stitches if they are Gorged when Stitches comes under the effects of Anub'arak's Web Blast.

=== Heroes: Tassadar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Tassadar no longer exhibits an animation pop when sitting idle on the Battle Beast Mount.
  • Grave Golems will now properly ignore Tassadar's Force Wall.
  • Fixed an issue in which Tassadar could gain additional range on Psionic Storm when selecting the talent Second Strike.
  • Tassadar will no longer display a targeting reticule during Dimensional Shift if he was being actively targeted before casting the Ability.

=== Heroes: The Lost Vikings ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — The Lost Vikings (Triple Trouble):
  • - Olaf (high Health, fast Health regeneration, charges to slow enemies), Baleog (splash damage behind target), and Erik (faster movement and longer attack range) move, attack, and respawn independently on separate timers.
  • - Hotkeys 1, 2, and 3 select individual Vikings; hotkey 4 guides them as a group.
  • - Mount — Go go go! (Z): Temporary Movement Speed increase for the Vikings.
  • - Trait — Fast Restart: Reduced death timers for The Lost Vikings.
  • - Basic Abilities (unlocked via Talents): Spin to Win! (Q, Level 4 talent), Jump! (W, Level 7 talent), and Norse Force! (E, Level 16 talent).
  • - Heroic Abilities (R): Play Again! (revives all Vikings and teleports them to the summoning Viking) and Longboat Raid! (summons a Longboat).

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Updates]
  • Battle Momentum (Talent) removed.
  • Frostwolf Resilience (Trait):
  • - Heal amount changed from 49 (+36 per level) to 60 (+23 per level).
  • Chain Lightning (Q):
  • - Primary target scaling damage reduced from 17 per level to 15 per level.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed a rare issue in which Earthquake could still be cast, and then receive a reduced cooldown, if Thrall was stunned while channeling the Ability.
  • Thrall's Chain Lightning will no longer bounce to, or reveal, Cloaked units.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Updates]
  • Minigun (Trait):
  • - Rapid Fire (Talent) reworked: Allows Minigun's Attack Speed bonus to stack up to two additional times.
  • Commandeer Odin (R):
  • - Functionality significantly changed: Odin Health is set to Tychus's current Health upon cast; Tychus dies if Odin is destroyed while piloting; Odin no longer has 50% Crowd Control reduction; Tychus can use Activated Talents while piloting.
  • - Basic Attack: Range increased by ~30%; Attack Speed increased by 9%; damage decreased from 70 (+20 per level) to 63 (+18 per level).
  • - Annihilate (Q): Scaling damage increased from 13 to 18 per level.
  • - Ragnarok Missiles (W): Target a point to damage and slow enemies in an area.
  • - New Ability — Thrusters (E): Dash in target direction.
  • - Big Red Button (Talent): No longer grants Nuclear Blast (E); instead Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile at the target location.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Updates]
  • Cast Aside (Talent) removed.
  • Righteousness (W):
  • - Angelic Absorption (Talent): Moved from Level 4 to Level 13; healing increased from 10 (+2 per level) to 20 (+4 per level) each second for 3 seconds.
  • Smite (E):
  • - Purge Evil (Talent): Damage bonus decreased from 30% to 25%.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Updates]
  • Holy Radiance (W):
  • - Gathering Radiance (Talent): No longer increases healing done; instead increases damage dealt by 10% for each enemy hit up to a maximum of 100%.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Updates]
  • Executioner (Talent) removed.
  • Bolt of the Storm (Talent) removed.
  • Rewind (Talent) added at Level 20.
  • Rending Cleave (Talent) moved from Level 7 to Level 16.
  • Void Slash (Talent) moved from Level 16 to Level 7.
  • Void Prison (R):
  • - Now pauses Capture Points (Mercenary Camps, Watch Towers, Dragon Shrines), preventing capture while paused.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Grave Golems, Mercenaries, and Minions will no longer completely ignore Structures affected by Zeratul's Void Prison.

• - New Level 13 Talent — Puttin' On a Clinic: Reduces Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds whenever an enemy recently damaged by Raynor is destroyed.
• Basic Attack:
• - Damage reduced from 40 (+12 per level) to 35 (+11 per level).
• Penetrating Round (Q):
• - New Level 4 Talent — Confident Aim: Cooldown reduced by 4 seconds upon striking an enemy Hero.
• - New Level 7 Talent — Hamstring Shot: Slows enemies by 20% for 3 seconds on impact.
• - New Level 13 Talent — Double Barreled: Becomes charge-based with up to 2 charges.
• Inspire (W):
• - Attack damage bonus removed.
• - Attack Speed bonus increased from 15% to 25% (nearby allies still receive 50% of this bonus).
• - No longer visually scales up Minions and Mercenaries.
• - New Level 13 Talent — Steel Resolve: Increases Inspire duration by 50% and causes Adrenaline Rush to automatically apply Inspire.
• Adrenaline Rush (E):
• - Activated Rush (Talent) moved from Level 13 to Level 4; now dismounts Raynor upon activation.
• - No longer requires activation to reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown; cooldown reduction lowered from 15 to 10 seconds.
• Hyperion (R):
• - Battle Hyperion (Talent) removed.
• - Now starts with the Yamato Cannon effect previously granted by the Battle Hyperion Talent.
• - New Level 20 Talent — Scorched Earth: Additional lasers continually blast the ground for area-of-effect damage.
• Raynor's Raiders (R):
• - Now requires a target before it can be cast.
• - Banshees can be re-targeted by pressing R and clicking an enemy, or issued Move commands by pressing R and clicking terrain.
• - Banshees acquire a nearby target (preferring Heroes) if their target dies, and travel to the nearest lane to push if Raynor dies.
• - New Level 20 Talent — Dusk Wings: Banshees remain cloaked while firing and fire 50% more frequently.
Heroes: Rehgar: • - Earthgrasp Totem (Talent): No longer roots for 1 second, instead applies a 90% slow for 1 second.
• Great-father Winter Rehgar's appearance while in Ghost Wolf form will now appropriately match his selected Skin Variation.
Heroes: Sgt. Hammer: • - Bullhead Mines (Talent): Enemies knocked back slightly farther, but only the center of the three Spider Mines knocks targets back.
• A Sgt. Hammer in Siege Mode now properly becomes mobile while under the effects of Brightwing's Polymorph, and will no longer be in Siege Mode when Polymorph expires.
• Visual explosion effects from Sgt. Hammer's Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode now appear at the appropriate location when attacking flying enemies.
Heroes: Sonya: • Fury resource bar color changed to orange.
• Ferocious Healing (Activated Talent): Fury cost upon activation increased from 10 to 20.
• - Damage increased from 38 (+7 per level) to 40 (+8 per level).
• - Fury generated per Basic Attack increased from 4 to 6.
• - Fury generated upon taking damage increased from 1 to 2.
• - Shot of Fury (Talent): Fury generated upon activation increased from 25 to 50.
• - Furious Blow (Talent): Damage bonus increased from 30% to 40%; increase to Seismic Slam's Fury cost changed from 5 to 10.
• - Fury required to extend Wrath of the Berserker's duration increased from 4 to 10 Fury.
Heroes: Stitches: • - Damage reduced from 200 (+50 per level) to 100 (+25 per level).
• Heroes will no longer be teleported back to Stitches if they are Gorged when Stitches comes under the effects of Anub'arak's Web Blast.
Heroes: Tassadar: • Tassadar no longer exhibits an animation pop when sitting idle on the Battle Beast Mount.
• Grave Golems will now properly ignore Tassadar's Force Wall.
• Fixed an issue in which Tassadar could gain additional range on Psionic Storm when selecting the talent Second Strike.
• Tassadar will no longer display a targeting reticule during Dimensional Shift if he was being actively targeted before casting the Ability.
Heroes: The Lost Vikings: • New Hero Released — The Lost Vikings (Triple Trouble):

• - Olaf (high Health, fast Health regeneration, charges to slow enemies), Baleog (splash damage behind target), and Erik (faster movement and longer attack range) move, attack, and respawn independently on separate timers.
• - Hotkeys 1, 2, and 3 select individual Vikings; hotkey 4 guides them as a group.
• - Mount — Go go go! (Z): Temporary Movement Speed increase for the Vikings.
• - Trait — Fast Restart: Reduced death timers for The Lost Vikings.
• - Basic Abilities (unlocked via Talents): Spin to Win! (Q, Level 4 talent), Jump! (W, Level 7 talent), and Norse Force! (E, Level 16 talent).
• - Heroic Abilities (R): Play Again! (revives all Vikings and teleports them to the summoning Viking) and Longboat Raid! (summons a Longboat).
Heroes: Thrall: • - Heal amount changed from 49 (+36 per level) to 60 (+23 per level).
• - Primary target scaling damage reduced from 17 per level to 15 per level.
• Fixed a rare issue in which Earthquake could still be cast, and then receive a reduced cooldown, if Thrall was stunned while channeling the Ability.
• Thrall's Chain Lightning will no longer bounce to, or reveal, Cloaked units.
Heroes: Tychus: • - Rapid Fire (Talent) reworked: Allows Minigun's Attack Speed bonus to stack up to two additional times.

• - Functionality significantly changed: Odin Health is set to Tychus's current Health upon cast; Tychus dies if Odin is destroyed while piloting; Odin no longer has 50% Crowd Control reduction; Tychus can use Activated Talents while piloting.
• - Basic Attack: Range increased by ~30%; Attack Speed increased by 9%; damage decreased from 70 (+20 per level) to 63 (+18 per level).
• - Annihilate (Q): Scaling damage increased from 13 to 18 per level.
• - Ragnarok Missiles (W): Target a point to damage and slow enemies in an area.
• - New Ability — Thrusters (E): Dash in target direction.
• - Big Red Button (Talent): No longer grants Nuclear Blast (E); instead Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile at the target location.
Heroes: Tyrael: • - Angelic Absorption (Talent): Moved from Level 4 to Level 13; healing increased from 10 (+2 per level) to 20 (+4 per level) each second for 3 seconds.
• - Purge Evil (Talent): Damage bonus decreased from 30% to 25%.
Heroes: Uther: • - Gathering Radiance (Talent): No longer increases healing done; instead increases damage dealt by 10% for each enemy hit up to a maximum of 100%.
Heroes: Zeratul: • Rending Cleave (Talent) moved from Level 7 to Level 16.
• Void Slash (Talent) moved from Level 16 to Level 7.
• - Now pauses Capture Points (Mercenary Camps, Watch Towers, Dragon Shrines), preventing capture while paused.
• Grave Golems, Mercenaries, and Minions will no longer completely ignore Structures affected by Zeratul's Void Prison.
